input.reflection: Findings: frontend /hotels p95 2.7s is driven by frontend->search.Nearby (2.67s), search->geo client span 0.6ms->2.66s p95, while geo server span stays ~0.24ms. Extra time sits on the search->geo wire, steady from start of window. Geo/search CPU, memory, restarts, uptime, network errors all normal; no error logs. Other services' flat p95s are just volume changes. Conclusion: one network_delay fault on search->geo; propagation geo->search->frontend. Rate, profile, reservation, user unaffected in latency.
